_comment: Dataset registry for the DONUT Receipt KIE pipeline. Add new datasets here.
_usage: When adding a new dataset: (1) add an entry here, (2) implement BaseDatasetLoader in dataset_loaders.py, (3) call memory_manager.release_hf_dataset() + flush_hf_arrow_cache() in your loader if it uses HuggingFace load_from_disk().

sroie.notes: Primary dataset. 80/10/10 train/val/test split from 626 labeled images.

wildreceipt.notes: Downloaded as tar archive. Annotations mapped to SROIE schema.

funsd.notes: Loaded via HuggingFace load_from_disk(). NER tags mapped to SROIE fields. Small dataset -- contributes layout diversity.

invoices_donut.notes: Loaded via HuggingFace load_from_disk(). Structured invoice data with all four SROIE fields well-represented.

cord_v2.notes: CORD-v2: ~1k Indonesian receipts with rich NER annotations. Loaded via HuggingFace load_from_disk(). Fields mapped: store_name→company, payment.date→date, store_addr→address, total.total_price→total. Address coverage ~60% (lower than other fields). DatasetNormalizer coverage_threshold set to 0.30. release_hf_dataset() + flush_hf_arrow_cache() called after sample extraction.
